Title: Replies submitted, but never gets confirmed in browser

Messages.Author: jamesatzephyr
Messages.Body:
Is anyone else seeing slightly curious behaviour?

I submit a reply, and my browser (Chrome) submits it and the spinny ball in the V:EKN tab spins round telling me it's submitting the response. And it just stays there doing that. In another tab, I can see the response has been submitted (because the thread has been updated and I can see my reply), but the other tab just continues sitting there looking like it's still submitting without getting a response from the webserver.

I've only seen this behaviour in the last 24 hours or so where, to the best of my knowledge, I haven't changed anything at my end.
